label: Raw vs existing export
sql: SELECT dataset_id, session, name, episode_id, exported, policy_steps FROM episodes WHERE dataset_id = 'tactile-umi' AND exported = false ORDER BY session, name

label: Time quality by session and modality
sql: SELECT e.dataset_id, e.session, m.stage, m.modality, m.name, SUM(m.value) AS total FROM metrics m JOIN episodes e ON m.episode_id=e.episode_id WHERE m.origin='computed' AND m.name IN ('samples','backwards','duplicates','long_gaps') GROUP BY e.dataset_id,e.session,m.stage,m.modality,m.name ORDER BY e.dataset_id,e.session,m.stage,m.modality,m.name

label: Mapped age diagnostic intervals
sql: SELECT e.dataset_id,e.session,e.name,f.start,f.end,f.index_space,f.message FROM findings f JOIN episodes e ON f.episode_id=e.episode_id WHERE f.rule='mapped_age_over_threshold' ORDER BY e.dataset_id,e.session,e.name,f.start

label: Six-record windows / native-frame reuse
sql: SELECT e.dataset_id,e.session,m.modality,SUM(m.value) AS repeated_windows,SUM(m.denominator) AS policy_windows FROM metrics m JOIN episodes e ON m.episode_id=e.episode_id WHERE m.name='repeated_native_source_windows' AND m.origin='imported_analysis' GROUP BY e.dataset_id,e.session,m.modality ORDER BY e.dataset_id,e.session,m.modality

label: Calibration impact across representations
sql: SELECT c.calibration_id,c.direction,e.session,e.name,b.stage,b.binding_id FROM calibrations c JOIN episodes e ON c.episode_id=e.episode_id JOIN bindings b ON e.episode_id=b.episode_id GROUP BY c.calibration_id,c.direction,e.session,e.name,b.stage,b.binding_id ORDER BY c.calibration_id,e.session,e.name,b.stage

label: Candidate selection and exclusion reasons
sql: SELECT e.episode_id,e.dataset_id,e.session,e.name,e.exported,COUNT(f.finding_id) AS error_findings FROM episodes e LEFT JOIN findings f ON e.episode_id=f.episode_id AND f.severity='error' GROUP BY e.episode_id,e.dataset_id,e.session,e.name,e.exported ORDER BY e.dataset_id,e.session,e.name
